name: Wagner Group | Rebellion, Leader, Syria, Founder, & Russia
snippet: The Wagner Group is a Russian mercenary group that has conducted military operations around the world on behalf of the Russian government. Though its origins are murky, the most credible account of the group’s creation traces it back to 2013. Since then, it has operated in Syria, multiple countries in Africa, and Ukraine.
